text_lines: For the morning light that reveals your mercy, we pray: Lord, hear us.
For the Church seeking truth and courage in every age, we pray: Lord, hear us.
For the poor, the sick, and the weary, we pray: Lord, hear us.
For all who lead and serve the faithful, we pray: Lord, hear us.
For the peace of the world and the coming of your kingdom, we pray: Lord, hear us.
